name: H3 EPS-style video noise scaling (monkey patch)
plain: Replaces core's H3 noise scaling so the video stream keeps its full latent at every sigma, which leaves written transition frames in place as a start point. Audio keeps the flow formula, because code comments explain that its scaled signal would overload otherwise. It does this by swapping the H3 class in comfy.model_base, so it affects every H3 in the process.
math:
added = σ·scale·ε.
Video elements: x = added + latent (no (1−σ) attenuation).
Audio elements: x = added + (1−σ)·latent.
If the stream split is unknown, everything takes the video form.

providers.author: fxai666
providers.note: Global patch at import; comment says first block cache lives elsewhere

label: from code
surprise: Importing this pack changes noise scaling for all H3 runs, whether or not its nodes are used. The new noise_scaling sits on one model_sampling instance, and core's MiniMaxH3SigmaShift builds a fresh instance, so that node would drop it (inference from reading; not run).
